office_does: The auditor runs elections and voter registration, records documents, licenses vehicles and vessels, and handles county financial services such as payroll and financial reports.
race_blurb: Two auditor's office employees, both preferring the Independent Party: appointed Auditor Nicole Deskins, chosen by the commissioners in 2025, and election administrator Dotsi Graves, the other finalist for that appointment. Graves led the primary by 22 votes.

candidates.summary: The auditor's office election administrator and a former chief deputy auditor, citing 30 years of county service.
highlights: Worked in the auditor's office 2003-2007, rising to chief deputy; election administrator since 2023 [S1]
Says she is the county's only certified election administrator [S1]
Was the other finalist when the commissioners appointed Deskins in 2025 [S2]

experience.basis: Long county service and election certification, though she has not held the top office.

candidates.summary: Appointed county auditor since December 2025 and former office and accounting manager in the auditor's office.
highlights: Appointed auditor by a 3-0 commission vote in October 2025 [S2]
Cites a new payroll system and county website during her tenure [S1]
Defended the county's mail-ballot procedures amid federal moves to restrict mail voting [S4]

experience.basis: Sitting appointed auditor running on her first year in the job.
